benefit: German chamomile interplanted with alliums is reported to improve bulb sulfur content and onion flavor. Chamomile flowers attract hoverflies that suppress onion thrips populations. Traditional European garden pattern with field-confirmed beneficial-insect benefit.

members.title: Chamomile every fifth allium row
members.body: Transplant chamomile every fifth row in allium blocks. Cut for tea harvest before plants shade alliums.
